Name: Disclosure of general basis for preparation of sustainability statement
Filled Data: The sustainability statement has been prepared in accordance with the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) as adopted under the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). It is based on information derived from internal policies processes and data collection systems and reflects the undertaking’s material sustainability impacts risks and opportunities identified through a double materiality assessment. Estimates and assumptions have been applied where necessary using best available data and methodologies consistent with ESRS requirements

Name: Basis for preparation of sustainability statement
Filled Data: The sustainability statement has been prepared on a consolidated basis and in line with the same reporting period and boundaries as the financial statements. It incorporates qualitative and quantitative information relevant to sustainability matters prepared using recognized internal controls governance processes and data management practices and aligned with applicable ESRS measurement and disclosure principles.

Name: Scope of consolidation of consolidated sustainability statement is same as for financial statements
Filled Data: The scope of consolidation of the consolidated sustainability statement is the same as that applied for the consolidated financial statements including all entities over which the undertaking exercises control in accordance with applicable financial reporting standards.

Name: Indication of subsidiary undertakings included in consolidation that are exempted from individual or consolidated sustainability reporting
Filled Data: Certain subsidiary undertakings included in the scope of consolidation are exempted from preparing individual or consolidated sustainability statements where permitted by applicable legislation as their sustainability information is fully included within the consolidated sustainability statement of the undertaking.

Name: Disclosure of extent to which sustainability statement covers upstream and downstream value chain
Filled Data: The sustainability statement covers the undertaking’s own operations as well as material impacts risks and opportunities related to its upstream and downstream value chain to the extent relevant and proportionate. Where full information is not available the undertaking has applied reasonable estimates and explanatory assumptions in line with ESRS requirements.

Filled Data: The undertaking has not exercised the option to omit specific pieces of information relating to intellectual property know-how or the results of innovation that would materially affect the understanding of its sustainability impacts risks or opportunities.
